description:
Find websites that sell guest posts, with the best public price, by filters.

    Each site: domain, DR, traffic, topics, language, country, prices per marketplace, best price and where,
    link_type (dofollow, or unknown — not specified by the marketplace). DR — Ahrefs (Domain Rating by Ahrefs,
    credit it with a link to https://ahrefs.com/ when shown) where dr_source is "ahrefs", otherwise as reported by
    sellers; traffic as reported by sellers. Universities, government sites and large brands (DR 90+ or 3M+
    traffic) are left out: they sell user-generated posts rather than guest posts. Placement format and terms are
    confirmed with the seller on the marketplace.

    Data caveats: country, language and topic are known only for part of the sites, so filtering by them returns
    fewer sites than really exist.

    Paging: pass next_offset from the previous response as offset. Without sign-in only the first 10 sites of a
    search are available (asking for more makes the client offer sign-in); signed in up to 50 per call and 1,000
    per day.

    Args:
        niche: Price for a special niche: general (default), igaming, crypto, cbd or adult
        topic: Site topic, or several comma-separated (any of them), from: news, business, finance, crypto, tech, marketing, health, beauty, fashion, home,
            realestate, auto, travel, food, sports, gaming, entertainment, education, family, pets,
            lifestyle, law, science, industry, society, shopping, gambling, adult, cbd
        country: ISO 3166 code of the site's audience, e.g. us, gb, de, dk
        language: ISO 639-1 code, e.g. en, de, es
        min_dr: Minimum DR
        min_traffic: Minimum monthly organic traffic
        min_price: Minimum best price of a guest post, USD
        max_price: Maximum price of a guest post, USD
        sort: dr_traffic (default: high DR and high traffic first — DR/100 × log-scaled traffic capped at 1,000,000/month,
            unknown traffic counts as ~1,000/month), dr (highest first), traffic (highest first) or price (cheapest first)
        offset: Skip this many results (from next_offset)
        limit: How many sites to return (up to 50 with a token, 10 without)
name: search_sites
title: Search guest post sites
